message.content:
The capital of Australia is **Canberra**.

It's worth noting that it isn't the country's largest city — Sydney and Melbourne are both much bigger. Canberra was actually purpose-built as the capital in the early 1900s as a compromise after Sydney and Melbourne both lobbied to hold the title.
